headline: Furious Assaults Sweep Stlican Shelf and Fisherman's Row
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, ferocious volatility has accelerated across the island waters and eastern heights. Fisherman's Row endured a blistering fourteen base transfers over the past two hours alone, stabilizing for the moment into six Colonial strongholds against three Warden redoubts. To the east, Stlican Shelf reignited with five rapid changes of hands, leaving the sector divided between five Warden positions, three Colonial, and one base reduced to rubble. Decisive shifts struck Linn of Mercy, where three fresh turnovers around contested Lathair ended with Colonial forces establishing full dominion across all eleven strategic bases. Along the Farranac Coast, three recent clashes at The Bone Haft concluded in Colonials securing every base in the hex. Conversely, the rapid territorial see-saw in Weathered Expanse and Stonecradle has halted over the last two hours, with both fronts remaining evenly split as heavy casualty rates endure. Callahan's Passage likewise registered no ground changes despite an immense burst of mutual bloodletting that claimed over twenty-three hundred casualties in two hours.
